text:
Alex K: quick FYI — hit a tiny window with stale reads after prefix handoff in canary. repro harness attached. logs: 
```
2026-03-21T09:11:02Z handoff start prefix=tenant/900 from=shard-3 to=shard-9 epoch=210
2026-03-21T09:11:02Z apply last_applied=210 prefix=tenant/900
2026-03-21T09:11:02Z read served_from_cache=true cached_epoch=209 owner_epoch=210
```
client sees old value for ~150ms until next write. wondering if this is ordering between announcing ownership and making last_applied visible.

Maria D: can you confirm if prefill finished before ownership was advertised? we saw similar in infra canary last month.

Alex K: sometimes prefill lagged ~50ms. ownership was advertised immediately because we wanted low handoff latency.

Samir R: quick proposals: (A) add an epoch check on read: if cached_epoch < owner_epoch, do a sync store read; (B) publish invalidation on handoff; (C) change handshake to advertise ownership only after local snapshot applied.

Lee P: (A) is cheap if owner_map is in-memory and RCU-protected. (B) is best-effort pubsub and needs fallback. (C) is safest but touches control plane and increases handoff tail latency.

Nora T: ops worry: too many invalidations -> rehydrate storm -> GPU spikes. need cooldown / suppress for cold prefixes.

Alex K: pragmatic plan: implement (A) + (B) behind a runtime flag; add cooldown for invalidations and a kill-switch. long-term RFC for (C).

Samir R: I'll implement the read-side epoch guard + metric evict.epoch_mismatch. unit tests for lost invalidation and perf microbench included.

Lee P: I'll add invalidation publish on handoff with fields: prefix, new_epoch, last_write_ts, nonce, and a hint prefill=true/false. add backoff knob.

Maria D: ops: Nora will add dashboard panels for stale_read_rate, invalidation_rate, rehydrate_qps. enable feature-flagged canary for 48h.

Nora T: will add alerts: stale_read_rate > 1/min or rehydrate_qps > baseline*2 triggers rollback.

infra-bot: NOTICE: invalidation channel subscription active on canary nodes (3).

Alex K: thanks. recap: Samir -> read-epoch PR + tests, Lee -> invalidation publisher + knobs, Nora -> dashboards + alerts, Maria -> canary plan, Alex -> open RFC for atomic handshake. target land this sprint behind flag.

Maria D: sounds good. :thumbsup:

Samir R: starting on PR now.

Lee P: infra pieces queued. will post when merged.

Alex K: closing loop once canary 48h passes or we see regressions.
